confidence_notes: A midyear Wellington price index supports the meal, cappuccino and draft beer estimates. [Restaurant price index](https://www.averagecostof.living/in/new-zealand/wellington/#restaurants) Cocktail and wine estimates reflect how local menus price them relative to beer. [Capitol drinks menu](https://capitolrestaurant.co.nz/winelist/) [Grazie menu](https://grazie.co.nz/menu/wellington/) Lodging is modeled for a typical July night outside major events, with the most uncertainty around very basic hotel rooms.
comparable_city_reasoning: Auckland and Christchurch provide broad benchmarks for urban lodging. The estimates account for Wellington's quieter winter leisure season and weekday business demand as the capital.
